name: Vietbuild HCMC 2026 — Phase 2
source: Vietbuild Construction International Fair Exhibition Corporation (organiser); dates cross-checked against eventseye and showsbee listings
note: Construction, building materials and interior/exterior decoration — the largest local trade fair, with a lighting and decoration section. Phase 1 ran 24–28 June 2026.

name: HKTDC Hong Kong International Lighting Fair (Autumn Edition)
venue: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
source: HKTDC official event page; cross-checked against Meetings & Exhibitions Hong Kong listing
note: The closest large-scale sourcing fair to Vietnam. The Autumn edition is the bigger of the two; a Spring edition runs in April.

name: LDI — Live Design International
venue: Las Vegas Convention Center, West Hall
source: LDI Show official site (show overview). Expo runs 6–8 December; Pro Training runs 2–8 December
note: Entertainment and architainment lighting — the strongest place to see DMX and pixel control in the flesh.

name: Light + Building
source: Messe Frankfurt official site. Biennial — this is the next edition after March 2026
note: The industry's largest biennial fair. Trade visitors only; private visitors are not admitted.

name: IALD Enlighten Europe 2026
source: arc magazine, 'Registration opens for IALD Enlighten Europe 2026'; confirmed by A1 Lighting and EdisonReport
unverifiableUrl: iald.org sits behind Cloudflare and returns 403 to any automated check. This URL was confirmed by hand, so the link checker skips it rather than reporting a false failure.
note: Boutique conference, capped below 400 attendees. Watch for the 2027 edition — the call for presentations usually opens the previous November.

name: [d]arc awards 2026 — [d]arc night
note: Peer-voted, run by arc and darc magazines with Light Collective. Categories: Structures, Places, Spaces, Art, Event, Kit. Entry for the next cycle usually opens in the autumn — the site was still showing the previous edition when last checked.
